title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Back-End), Inference
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

WHY THIS ROLE?

This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.

AS A SENIOR/STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

- Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.

- Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.

- Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.

- Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.

- Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.

- Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.

- Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

- You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security.

- You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness.

- You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale.

- You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems.

- You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation.

- You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation

title: Senior Third-Party Risk Management Analyst
description:
Job Description
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)Analyst serves as a core member of Momentive Software 's Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance organization. This role is responsible for maintaining and maturing Momentive's enterprise-wide third-party risk program, ensuring that all vendors, platforms, and service providers meet the Firm's cybersecurity, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory requirements.
The Analyst partners closely with Client Success, Cybersecurity Engineering, TVM, Legal, Procurement, Product, and the CISO to evaluate vendor risk, maintain continuous oversight of third-party controls, and support Momentive's compliance obligations - including SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS. The role also supports TVM notifications to clients who manage their own cybersecurity posture, ensuring clear, accurate, and timely communication of vulnerabilities and remediation expectations.
This position requires strong analytical capability, deep familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, and the ability to translate complex risk issues into actionable guidance for business and technical stakeholders.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Third-Party Risk Management Program

• Maintain Momentive's global inventory of third-party providers, applications, and services from onboarding through termination.

• Lead vendor cybersecurity assessments, coordinating with Cybersecurity Engineering, Legal, and business owners to evaluate risk and required controls.

• Assess vendor maturity using NIST CSF, CIS, CMMC, GDPR, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other frameworks.

• Oversee vendor SLAs, RPO/RTO commitments, breach notification requirements, and cybersecurity insurance documentation.

• Ensure thorough documentation of findings, recommendations, and remediation plans for all vendor assessments.

• Serve as a liaison to internal and external auditors for vendor-related controls and evidence collection.
Support for PCI DSS & SOC 2 Type II Audits

• Provide evidence, documentation, and control validation related to third-party dependencies for Momentive's SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS assessments.

• Ensure vendor controls align with Momentive's ISMS, contractual obligations, and certification requirements.

• Partner with the GRC team to maintain audit-ready documentation, including policies, standards, procedures, and risk treatment plans.

• Track vendor exceptions and compensating controls, ensuring audit defensibility and continuous improvement.
TVM Notifications & Client Support

• Collaborate with the Threat & Vulnerability Management (TVM) team to support vulnerability notifications to clients who manage their own cybersecurity controls.

• Ensure communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with Momentive's contractual commitments and industry best practices.

• Provide consultative guidance to clients regarding risk impact, remediation expectations, and recommended cybersecurity practices.

• Maintain documentation and metrics related to client notifications, follow-up actions, and closure.
Governance, Risk & Compliance Integration

• Contribute to the continual improvement of Momentive's ISMS by aligning vendor risk processes with Firm policies, standards, and procedures.

• Provide input on control selection, risk treatment plans, and metrics used to monitor the effectiveness of Momentive's cybersecurity controls.

• Maintain situational awareness of emerging threats, regulatory changes, and industry trends affecting third-party risk.

• Support DR/BCP planning as it relates to vendor dependencies and resiliency requirements.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership

• Act as a key point of contact when business units identify vendor-related risk; coordinate with Legal, Cybersecurity, and leadership on risk reduction strategies.

• Promote a positive, enterprise-wide cybersecurity culture through outreach, training, and awareness activities.

• Provide exemplary service to internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating professionalism, empathy,

title: Senior Security Application Engineer - Automation & Detection

• Build and ship agentic detection and response - own the full lifecycle from threat use case through detections-as-code, automated triage, and production agentic response workflows.

• Build and maintain automation for signing pipelines, HSM health monitoring, certificate lifecycle management, and access provisioning workflows integrated into CI/CD.

• Integrate security requirements (SAST, SBOM generation and validation, attestation signing, supply-chain controls) across firmware build and release pipelines.

• Validate security controls through adversary emulation and purple team exercises; close coverage gaps identified through testing and operational feedback.

• Operate within and strengthen NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST FIPS 140-3, NSA CNSA 2.0+, OCP 2.5 to 3.0+, and ISO 27001/SOX ITGC governance gates.

Technical Leadership & Expectations

• Lead security program components and define detection, automation, and cryptographic governance standards - not just execute them.

• Shape the product and application security engineering roadmap through threat modeling, control design, and input to the Cryptographic Architecture Board and security roadmap.

• Serve as initial point of contact for cross-team security engineering projects; align technical outcomes with business requirements across firmware, manufacturing, and operations.

• Mentor MSP analysts, junior security engineers, and firmware engineers on agentic patterns, detection best practices, and cryptographic operational hygiene - multiplying team effectiveness.

League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Observe by Snowflake
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built natively on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Its Telemetry Lakehouse Foundation enables organizations to ingest, retain, and analyze massive volumes of telemetry more economically than traditional observability platforms while keeping data reusable across analytics and AI through open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. Its Observability Context Graph captures relationships across services, infrastructure, logs, metrics, and traces, providing the semantic context needed to reason about complex systems. A programmable AI SRE automates investigation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate incident resolution.

Trusted by engineering teams at organizations including Capital One, HPE, and Breeze Airways, Observe ingests and analyzes hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining enterprise-scale reliability. Observe joined Snowflake through its acquisition in February 2026.

The Infrastructure team at Observe by Snowflake is responsible for architecting, scaling, and operating the development and production environments that power our observability platform. We are a small, highly collaborative team with broad scope and high ownership, focused on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure while continuously evolving the systems that support our engineers and customers.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping our infrastructure strategy, driving architectural decisions, and elevating operational excellence across the organization. Examples of the work you'd take on include launching single-tenant and multi-tenant environments for new customers on tight timelines, migrating our Kubernetes ingress from Ingress-NGINX to Envoy and the Gateway API, shifting our release process from script-driven lockstep weekly deploys to GitOps with ArgoCD, and building repeatable processes for infrastructure upgrades, refreshes, and migrations across the fleet.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the design, build, and operation of scalable, secure AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure across shared and dedicated customer environments, supporting a high-scale observability platform.

- Help integrate Observe's infrastructure into Snowflake's platforms, including CI, source control, and container platform migrations, bridging startup-era systems with enterprise-grade standards.

- Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and platform automation, moving our delivery pipeline toward GitOps and independent, safe service deployments.

- Partner with the Security team to improve access controls, secrets management, and the security posture of production environments, enabling other teams (including AI and automation initiatives) to move fast without compromising security or maintainability.

- Design and implement infrastructure patterns that ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.

- Participate in the infrastructure on-call rotation and play a key role in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements that drive systemic reliability enhancements.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to ensure infrastructure strategy supports long-term platform evolution.

Reporting to the Managing Director, you’ll take financial responsibility for a portfolio of services across our South West and Wales region, working with senior leaders to improve financial performance, achieve business objectives and identify opportunities for commercial growth. This is a remote role, with the successful candidate required to be based within the region. Frequent travel across South West England and Wales, and to other Priory locations, will be required, including overnight stays. A full UK driving licence is essential. This role is offered on a 12-month fixed-term contract.

What you'll be doing

You will partner with the Managing Director, Hospital Directors and Service Managers to drive financial performance, provide commercial insight and support effective decision-making.
Your responsibilities will include :

• Producing month-end reports, analysing variances and identifying risks and opportunities.

• Managing budgets and forecasts, monitoring performance and recommending corrective action where needed.

• Supporting tenders, pricing, fee uplifts and contract renewals.

• Evaluating business cases and new opportunities to drive commercial growth.

• Maintaining strong financial controls and investigating financial discrepancies.

• Attending monthly business reviews with the Managing Director, recommending actions to improve performance.

• Building financial awareness across services through guidance and training for non-finance colleagues.

• Contributing to wider Group projects and operational improvements.

What you'll bring to the role

You will bring experience as a Commercial Manager, Management Accountant or in a similar finance role, with a strong understanding of financial management and commercial performance. You’ll be confident working autonomously, balancing competing priorities and translating financial insights into practical solutions that improve business performance. With strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, you’ll be able to:

• Identify opportunities to improve financial and commercial performance.

• Build effective relationships with senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders, influencing decisions and driving improvements.

• Translate financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Improve financial awareness and support better decision-making across services.

This position is a leadership role at Priory and during the interview process we will be assessing candidates against our leadership behaviours. These are a set of ten values driven behaviours that define great leadership at Priory . They are integral to driving a positive high performing culture where we strive to deliver the best care and outcomes for the people we support. You can find out more about our interview approach and our leadership behaviours here .

What we will give you in return

We want you to succeed at Priory and thrive in your role. You will be well supported with regular career conversations. We also offer full training and numerous pathways into leadership and qualified clinical positions to help you shape your career with us.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager - NAM & EMEA
Delivery | Remote, US | Full-Time | NAM
Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts
Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.
What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office
We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
You'll run a portfolio of enterprise client projects across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems, taking each one from pitch to plan to delivery. On any given week you'll have several projects live at once, from platform upgrades to full implementations, each with its own technical team and its own client executives. You sit at the center of it: the person our consultants, partner vendors and client leadership all look to for a straight answer on status, risk and what happens next. You also own the numbers, keeping every project on budget and on margin. Clients judge BPX on whether projects land on time and on budget, which makes this role central to how they see us. Internally, this position maps to our Project Manager role within our global structure.
What you'll do

• Lead concurrent projects across Adobe and Salesforce, from platform upgrades to full enterprise implementations.

• Direct technical teams of consultants and platform specialists deploying front-office solutions inside complex client environments.

• Keep clients confident through clear status reporting and honest risk conversations with executive stakeholders.

• Hold every project to margin, managing budget, resourcing and revenue reporting against target.

• Report the financials accurately for implementation projects and retained services engagements alike.

• Run delivery in Kantata and Jira, tracking project health and resource allocation, with AI flagging risks earlier.

• Pick the right method for each engagement, waterfall or agile, and adjust when the project changes shape.

• You'll work with clients and colleagues across multiple regions, so some flexibility with your working hours to accommodate different time zones will be needed from time to time.

What you'll bring

• Enterprise delivery experience: 8+ years managing technology implementations for enterprise clients, ideally in a consultancy.

• Adobe or Salesforce depth, having delivered Adobe Experience Cloud or Salesforce projects and understood the technical detail.

• Multi-project control, with a track record of running several client projects at once without losing the thread.

• Commercial ownership of project budgets, margin, change requests and statements of work.

• Executive presence to lead status meetings and hard conversations about risk with senior client stakeholders.

• Waterfall and agile fluency; PMP, PRINCE2 or Scrum certification is a plus.

• Delivery tooling know-how in PSA and work-tracking platforms such as Kantata and Jira.
Why this role, why now
BPX is growing on private equity backing, and each new Adobe and Salesforce client adds projects that need someone to run them well. You'll step into a varied enterprise portfolio with direct access to client executives

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable.

You won't wait to be asked. You'll identify what's broken before it becomes a problem, build solutions that didn't exist yesterday, and earn the kind of trust that makes you indispensable to the agency - and to Axon.

In this embedded role, you are the primary owner of customer outcomes within a strategic account - accountable for the full lifecycle of Axon's ecosystem. You combine deep technical expertise, builder instinct, operational leadership, and executive presence to help agencies transform how they operate, not just adopt software. You embed for the long haul: opening the laptop onsite, shipping on Axon's stack, holding the room when it matters, and iterating on what you build until it sticks in production.

Success is measured by the agency's operational outcomes and working solutions in production - not product health, not activity, not slideware.

What You'll Do

This role is intentionally undefined in the day-to-day. Priorities shift with agency mission tempo, operational crises, and emerging opportunities. If you need a fixed playbook to succeed, this isn't the role for you.

• Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed

Testing & Validation

Stakeholder Collaboration

Requirements

title: Senior Reverse Engineer - Remote
description:
At Zyte , we're pioneering the next revolution in web data extraction, empowering businesses to focus on innovation. Companies often struggle with challenges like navigating dynamic web structures, countering anti-scraping measures, and ensuring data accuracy. We tackle these obstacles by providing best-in-class tools for seamless, reliable web data extraction. With over a decade of expertise, we've become the trusted solution for over 3,000 companies and a million developers, helping them achieve a competitive edge and drive sustainable growth.
We are a diverse and enthusiastic team of data nerds, tech aficionados, and hackers. At Zyte , you'll join an inclusive community where everyone belongs. We thrive on collaborating with our smart, passionate teammates and customers to solve complex problems in data science and engineering.
Join us and be part of the data revolution!

About the Job
Reverse engineering is at the heart of how Zyte stays ahead in the banning war. We've cracked some of the hardest antibots on the web - but the ground shifts weekly: antibots ship new sensor formats overnight, obfuscation schemes mutate, and new fingerprinting surfaces appear faster than any team could chase by hand.
This role is not about solving tickets one at a time. It's about building the tools, pipelines, and automation that let both engineers and AI agents solve them at scale. You will be the person who turns a reverse-engineering breakthrough into reusable tooling, who automates the investigation that used to take days into a readout that takes minutes, and who feeds the intelligence our AI systems learn from. You'll work at the intersection of deep JS/VM reverse engineering and modern AI-assisted engineering - using LLMs and agentic tooling aggressively to compress the loop between "new detection surface discovered" and "solution shipped."
If you're energized by wielding AI to multiply your own output, by automating away manual toil, and by working on problems where the adversary is smart and the target moves - this is the seat.

Roles & Responsibilities

• HubSpot maintenance and support: under 5%

• Quoting and deal desk: Administer DealHub so quote templates, playbooks, the product and pricing catalogue and approval workflows reflect our commercial guardrails. Maintain the DealHub to Salesforce mapping and support the sales team through quote build issues.

• Data quality and reporting: Regular audits, de duplication and health checks, plus reports and dashboards covering pipeline, funnel conversion, renewals and forecasting inputs. Understand the question behind the request and offer a view, not just the numbers.

• Integrations: Maintain the Salesforce to HubSpot sync and support Marketing’s use of the platform.

• External delivery: Own the relationship with our external Salesforce partner. Write clear requirements, challenge proposed designs, test and accept delivered work, and make sure it is documented and maintainable in house.

• Documentation and enablement: Keep system and process documentation current, produce simple guides, run drop in sessions, and promote good data habits across the business.

In your first six months we would expect the org properly documented, a prioritised remediation plan agreed with the highest risk items delivered, the support queue running to a predictable and visible standard, and DealHub quoting configuration aligned to current commercial guardrails.

title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer
description:
Mission Summary:

On our Motion Planning team, you'll apply your passion in robotics and software development for production-ready autonomous vehicles. In this role you'll perform cutting-edge research, develop advanced algorithms, and build robust software to generate safe, comfortable, and intuitive routes and motions.
Role responsibilities:

• Lead the research and development of novel algorithms for motion planning in autonomous driving, including but not limited to advanced search-based methods, sophisticated geometry-based methods, and decision making under uncertainty with a strong emphasis on probabilistic approaches.

• Architect and integrate complex combinations of motion planning and prediction algorithms, driving their evaluation and refinement for real-world deployment.

• Design and build a robust, scalable, and high-performance codebase that facilitates rapid exploration, prototyping, and rigorous evaluation of innovative motion planning approaches and algorithms.

• Drive technical collaboration and interface seamlessly with perception and prediction components upstream and trajectory optimization, tracking and control components downstream, ensuring end-to-end system performance.

• Leverage your deep software development and research expertise to teach others better software practices and principles, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

• Guide and mentor junior team members, cultivating a culture of product-focused engineering, rigorous research, and advanced development.

What we're looking for:

• PhD preferred in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; or a Master's degree with 2+ years of experience in the robotics (preferably AV industry)

• 5+ years of research experience in robotics / motion planning, with a proven track record of contributing to state-of-the-art solutions

• 3+ years of C++ software development, with an emphasis on developing high-performance and reliable systems

• Past experience owning and leading technical development on complex features from problem formulation through research, implementation, and deployment in a production environment.

• Thirst for knowledge, continuous innovation, and a drive to push the boundaries of autonomous driving technology.

Bonus points(not required):

• Experience with probabilistic models, including but not limited to Gaussian mixture models, Hidden Markov Models, and Particle Filters.

• Experience with Bayesian modeling and inference techniques for decision making under uncertainty.

• Experience with the Bazel build framework

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional ’s benefits program. Motional ’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.

$172,000-$229,000 USD

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places

About the role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic operator to help shape OpenAI’s GTM growth strategy and operating plan.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with GTM Leadership and Strategic Finance to translate company financial objectives into growth strategies, resource allocation decisions, and operating plans across regions, segments, and functions.

- Build headcount, capacity, and productivity models to inform where and how OpenAI invests across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM functions.

- Develop regional, segment, and team-level revenue targets, translating company financial goals into executable plans with clear accountability.

- Build scenario analyses to evaluate how hiring, productivity, product launches, partner distribution, and other growth levers affect revenue performance and investment requirements.

- Develop data-driven recommendations on segmentation, coverage models, organizational structure, and resource allocation to support growth and operational efficiency.

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)

Niveau : senior

Équipe : Client Delivery EMEA

Contrat : CDD de 12 mois

Rattachement : Operating Model Design Lead

À noter : Ce poste nécessite un droit au travail déjà acquis dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions la question poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Merci de postuler en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

- Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

- Être un partenaire de confiance : mener des analyses approfondies des besoins de formation pour comprendre les défis propres à chaque client, partenaire et équipe interne.

- Concevoir des programmes d’apprentissage sur mesure qui vont au-delà de la formation et produisent des résultats business mesurables.

- Créer des supports de formation de grande qualité, en français et en anglais : ateliers interactifs, modules d’e-learning et guides de référence rapide.

- Animer ces sessions à distance et en présentiel, en rendant le complexe simple et en renforçant la confiance de votre audience à chaque échange.

- Accélérer l’adoption de la plateforme Kaluza grâce à un accompagnement et à du coaching après la formation.

- Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.

Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

- Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

- Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

- Sens de la simplification : vous savez naturellement traduire des concepts techniques et métier complexes en supports clairs, engageants et pratiques.

- Talent d’animation : vous êtes un·e intervenant·e dynamique et sûr·e de vous, capable de captiver des publics variés et de créer un cadre d’apprentissage interactif et convivial.

- Esprit collaboratif et proactif : vous travaillez bien en équipe, vous construisez des relations solides et vous identifiez spontanément des façons d’aider les autres et de progresser en continu.

Idéalement, vous avez :

- Une connaissance du secteur de l’énergie : une expérience concrète des opérations d’un fournisseur d’énergie ou des technologies de décarbonation, pour relier la formation aux défis réels de nos clients.

- Une culture de l’excellence opérationnelle : une connaissance des processus de centre de contact ou des technologies de service client, pour concevoir des formations qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle.

- Une expérience de leadership en formation : un parcours démontré de montée en charge de programmes de format

title: Business System Analyst
description:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Partner with product owners, product managers, business stakeholders, and SMEs to elicit, analyze, validate, and document functional and non-functional needs, business rules, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Translate product objectives and business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, supporting documentation, and technical specifications that are ready for Agile delivery teams.

• Analyze complex business and technical issues, existing system logic, dependencies, and opportunities to improve product outcomes, operational performance, and member or stakeholder experience.

• Support product teams in defining scope, sequencing work, and clarifying requirements based on user needs, business value, system dependencies, existing architecture, and enterprise technology direction.

• Conduct impact analysis and assessments for proposed product changes to evaluate system dependencies, risks, effort estimates, and traceability needs that inform prioritization, backlog refinement, and delivery planning.

• Map business data elements to backend data sources, using SQL skills for accurate querying, validation, and source-to-target mapping.

• Create and maintain lightweight, fit-for-purpose documentation that supports product decisions, Agile delivery, system understanding, and downstream development or testing activities; review and provide feedback on vendor designs and deliverables.

• Act as a liaison between product, business, engineering, architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, support backlog refinement, and ensure a shared understanding of business value, technical scope, and acceptance criteria.

• Support Agile delivery teams throughout discovery, sprint planning, development, testing, defect triage, user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness, and post-release validation activities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience.

• Healthcare payer or health insurance industry experience.

• Experience with Facets or other healthcare payer adjudication systems.

• Experience with cloud-based platform integrations (Azure, Google Cloud, and Salesforce).

• Experience supporting Agile product delivery, including backlog refinement, user story development, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and collaboration with product owners and cross-functional delivery teams.

• CCBA, CBAP, or PMI-PBA certification, or familiarity with BABOK / IIBA standards.

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to healthcare (HIPAA, CMS, BCBSA, SOC1/SOC2)

• Ability to elicit, analyze, and document business, user, and product requirements, including process flows, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and conceptual data diagrams.

• Strong hands-on SQL skills for data mapping, querying, and validation across systems.

• Knowledge of requirements engineering, traceability matrices, and requirements management tools and techniques.

• Understanding of Agile delivery practices, software development lifecycles (SDLC), API and batch integration concepts, and modern web-based/client-server application design.

• Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Sr Offensive Security Engineer
description:
What You'll Do

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Offensive Security Engineer to join our Threat Management & Security Operations organization. In this hands-on role, you will think and operate like an adversary - continuously finding, exploiting, and helping remediate real-world weaknesses across First Advantage ’s products, cloud infrastructure, networks, and people. You will design and execute penetration tests, red and purple team engagements, and adversary emulation exercises that validate our detection and response capabilities and measurably reduce enterprise risk at-scale.

This role partners closely with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence & Hunt, Vulnerability Management, Application Security, DevOps, and Product teams to turn offensive findings into prioritized, business-aligned remediation. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building custom tooling, chaining exploits across complex environments, and communicating impact clearly to both technical teams and executive leadership.

Responsibilities

• Penetration Testing: Plan, scope, and execute internal and external penetration tests across web and mobile applications, APIs, cloud (AWS/Azure), networks, and infrastructure using real-world attacker techniques.

• Red & Purple Teaming: Design and run adversary emulation and red team engagements that combine multiple attack paths to accomplish objective-based goals, and partner with the SOC, Threat Intel & Hunt, and Detection Engineering on purple team exercises to validate and improve detection coverage.

• Exploit Development & Chaining: Identify, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities - including chaining lower-severity issues into high-impact attack paths - and demonstrate tangible business impact in production-representative environments.

• Adversary Emulation: Model real-world threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to test and strengthen organizational resilience, detection, and response.

• Findings & Remediation: Review and validate findings for accuracy, prioritize real-world exploitability and business risk, create remediation tickets, and partner with engineering teams to drive fixes and coordinate retests within policy SLAs.

• Tooling & Automation: Build and maintain custom scripts, tooling, and automation to scale offensive testing, and help operationalize continuous/autonomous testing platforms across the environment.

• Reporting & Communication: Produce clear, decision-ready reports and executive summaries that translate technical findings into risk and business impact for technical stakeholders, GRC/Audit, and executive leadership.

• Incident Response Support: Support incident response and threat hunting efforts by providing offensive expertise, attack-path context, and adversary insight.

• Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the maturity of the offensive security program - developing repeatable methodologies, playbooks, and metrics that demonstrate progress over time.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a closely related security engineering role.

• Demonstrated expertise across multiple domains: web/mobile application, API, network, infrastructure, and cloud (AWS and/or Azure) penetration testing.

• Strong understanding of exploitation and post-exploitation techniques, attack-path chaining, and objective-based adversary emulation.

• Proficiency with industry-standard offensive tooling such as Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, Metasploit, and Kali Linux, along with vulnerability scanners.

• Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, PowerShell, Ruby, or Bash) to build custom tools and automation.

• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and hands-on experience mapping engagements to adversary TTPs.

title: Field Sales Representative - Amsterdam
description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

- Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

- Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

- Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

- Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

- Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

- Dutch fluency is a must 

- Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

- Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

- Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

- Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

- Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

- General technical proficiency with software

- Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

- Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

- Uncapped commission

- Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

- An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

- Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

- Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

- Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

- Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

- People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

- LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

- Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

- Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

WHERE TO FROM HERE?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here https://www.lightspeedhq.com/care

title: Stage - Ingénieur Structure Offshore - Etude Impact Module sans Bracons - F/H
description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.
Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.
Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.
Missions proposées :
Les unités flottantes offshore sont constituées de plusieurs modules.
Chacun de ces modules est un ensemble de Poutres, Colonnes tubulaires et Bracons horizontaux et verticaux tubulaires.
L’objectif de ces Bracons est d’assurer la stabilité de la charpente durant les différentes phases de la vie de la plate-forme.
L’objectif du stage est de faire une étude comparative d’un module, avec et sans les Bracons verticaux :

• Impact sur la stabilité et les deflections

• Impact sur le dimensionnement (tenue a la charge et fatigue)

• Impact sur la constructabilité

• Impact sur le poids et le centre de gravité

L’étude devra souligner les éventuels limitations et/ou champ d’application
Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.
Profil recherché:
Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

• En cours de Bac +5 en ingénierie des structures offshore ou ingénierie navale ou mécanique

• Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques

• Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?
Envoyez-nous votre candidature!
Votre carrière chez nous :
Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives. Entouré(e) de personnes diverses aux nombreux talents, vous vous sentirez accueilli(e), respecté(e) et impliqué(e). Vous évoluerez dans un environnement sûr et bienveillant où vous pourrez proposer de nouvelles idées, réinventer l'avenir et conduire le changement. Au fur et à mesure de l'évolution de votre carrière, vous bénéficierez des possibilités d'apprentissage offertes par T.EN University, telles que le programme « Future Ready », et du soutien de votre manager, par exemple à l'occasion de l'entretien de mi-année, qui favorisent votre épanouissement et développement continus.
Prochaines étapes :
A réception de votre candidature, nos recruteurs évalueront vos compétences, votre expérience et votre aptitude à vous intégrer au sein de nos équipes en fonction des besoins du poste. Nous vous demandons un peu de patience pendant que l’équipe traite le volume de demandes dans les meilleurs délais ! Vous pourrez suivre son avancement via votre compte personnel à partir du profil que vous avez créé lors de votre candidature.
Retrouvez nos actualités en consultant le site et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, et YouTube.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - East
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

What You Will Achieve

- Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

- Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

- Navigate the C-Suite: Orchestrate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles, building deep trust with everyone from lead engineers to C-level executives.

- Collaborative Excellence: Partner with our expert Solutions Engineering team to prove the massive ROI and technical superiority of the Kong platform.

- Define Your Legacy: Maintain a pristine pipeline and deliver accurate forecasts that help shape the strategic direction of our sales organization.

What You Bring to the Journey

- A Track Record of Excellence: 8+ years of experience selling complex enterprise software platforms, with a history of consistently exceeding goals and reaching the top tier of your organization.

- Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

- Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

- Executive Presence: You are a compelling storyteller, capable of articulating the strategic business value of AI and APIs to the world’s most sophisticated technical leaders.

- Resilient Drive: You bring the persistence, grit, and proactive mindset required to win in a high-velocity, competitive landscape.

Why You’ll Thrive at Kong

- Category-Defining Technology: Sell a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to survive an AI-first world.

- Uncapped Opportunity: A competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure that rewards those who go above and beyond.

- Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there.

- Inclusive Excellence: We offer comprehensive health coverage, equity, flexible PTO, and a culture where diverse perspectives are the fuel for our innovation.

Our Commitment to You: At Kong, we believe that talent is diverse by nature. If you are excited about this role but your background doesn't perfectly match every single bullet point, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Authorizations Specialist (WFH)
description:
About FGC+

#SparkSuccess at FGC+ !

Since 2011, FGC+ has been committed to transforming US businesses through our all-inclusive outsourcing solutions. Through the years, we've built strong remote teams, developed customized processes, and provided exceptional customer service, helping companies soar to new heights. Our dedicated professionals excel in supporting a diverse range of industries with unmatched dedication.

Driven by our core values of Empathy, Reliability, Possibility, and Growth, we are focused on #IgnitingPossibility and helping each team member unlock their full potential. At FGC+ , we offer more than just a job; we provide a nurturing environment where work-life balance, mentorship, employee engagement, and continuous learning are the pillars of your success.

Here, you are more than just an employee -you are part of a team where you can truly thrive and make a difference.

About the Job:

Be part of a team that helps patients access the healthcare services they need! As an Authorization Specialist, you will play a vital role in bridging the gap between patients, healthcare providers, and insurance companies. You will review clinical documentation, coordinate authorizations and referrals, and work directly with insurance providers to secure medical necessity approvals. Through your attention to detail and effective communication, you will help ensure patients receive timely access to appropriate healthcare services while supporting providers in delivering quality care.

What You'll Do:

• Manage and process daily authorization requests from healthcare providers and facilities, ensuring timely and accurate completion.

• Initiate authorization requests through various insurance portals and direct communication with insurance companies.

• Follow up on pending authorizations, track their status, and address any delays or concerns.

• Prepare and process appeals for denied authorization requests.

• Advocate for patients and providers by coordinating with insurance companies to secure approvals across different levels of care.

• Collaborate with healthcare providers to obtain necessary documentation and clarify medical necessity requirements.

• Respond to inquiries from insurance companies, document relevant information, and communicate updates to providers.

• Review and interpret medical records to identify relevant clinical information needed for authorization requests.

• Maintain accurate account records and update documentation in accordance with client guidelines and established processes.

• Ensure all required forms, logs, and reports are completed accurately, thoroughly, and on time.

What You'll Bring:

• Previous experience in healthcare accounts, medical-related projects, or a similar field.

• Experience in Pre-Authorization, Utilization Review, or Case Management is a strong advantage.

• Strong probing, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess clinical information and address authorization concerns effectively.

• Ability to read, understand, and identify relevant information from medical records and clinical documentation.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with healthcare providers, insurance companies, clients, and colleagues.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling documentation, authorization requests, and account updates.

• Ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

• Proficiency in general computer applications, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel, and PDF tools.

• Ability to quickly learn and navigate new software systems and applications.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively as part of a team.

• Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and processes.

A million possibilities are waiting to be ignited. Click "Apply Now"!
